1879064209.name: Story of the Hammerhand
1879064209.desc: A story so potent that it provides you with a shield of morale that must be destroyed before you will begin losing morale again. The name comes from the adage that those who know this story were said to have been able to take a blow from Helm Hammerhand himself.\n\nBubble strength is 35% of your Max Morale pool before other bonuses apply.

1879064337.name: Reveal Weakness
1879064337.desc: Weaken enemy defences, increasing damage taken from attacks.\n\nUsing this skill will not break Stealth.

1879097873.name: Shelob's Gift
1879097873.desc:
Your ancestry affords you incredible powers of recovery. After successfully defeating an opponent, you can immediately drain them of vitality and restore your health.
This burst of vitality fills your Venom and briefly increases your toxicity.

   <rgb=#00FFDD>Requires a Defeat Response</rgb>

1879115153.name: Heart of Darkness
1879115153.desc: Reduces all incoming healing to zero, as well as reducing in and out of combat health regeneration to 0 for 30 seconds. The player has been granted a glimpse into Amarthiel's dark heart, and despairs.

1879117457.name: Piercing Strike
1879117457.desc: A piercing attack which deals Light Damage over time.

1879162769.name: Return to Thorin's Gate
1879162769.desc: Thanks to your friendship with the Dwarves of Thorin's Hall, you're able to quickly return to Thorin's Gate. This skill is easily interrupted.

1879198353.name: Friend of the Wilds (Tundra-guardian)
1879198353.desc: Summons a Bog-guardian companion.\n\nThe Bog-guardian excels at dealing damage from range.

1879208721.name: Monster Fare
1879208721.desc: Ingredients: Whole grain oats, Sandson's Farm chicken by-products, tater meal, toad concentrate, hobbit-toes, Elf-ears, dwarf-beards, added colours, people.\n\nYum! No wonder mobs eat this...

1879231377.name: Ranged Warden's Triumph
1879231377.desc: A triumphant blow, allowing the Warden to deal even more damage.

1879239569.name: Flay Open
1879239569.desc: You draw back your blade to carve a shallow gash through your enemy's flesh.

1879259921.desc: You strike out at your foe with a cunning trick.

1879260305.name: Radiant Blast
1879260305.desc: You hurl a lens toward your target distracting and potentially dismounting them. The glimmering light will attract a murder of crows to hamper the target's movement once the distraction dissipates.\n\n<rgb=#ff6600>This skill cannot be used on a target under the effects of 'Murder of Crows' the movement reducing effect applied by Radiant Burst.</rgb>

1879270545.name: Barrage of Fire 2
1879270545.desc: A quick attack that deals more damage each time it is used.

1879447697.desc:
Bolster your fellowship and raid members with a portion of your Innate Strength: Heavy.
<rgb=#FF0000>Requires a Tier 4 Innate Strength: Heavy buff to be present on the Brawler.</rgb>

1879489169.desc: Your companion shrugs off attacks for a brief period.

1879506833.name: Planned Attack
1879506833.desc: Your superior coordination energizes you and nearby allies.
